categories.name: Recognition
categories.description: Defines the parties, bargaining unit, scope of coverage, and the union’s representative status.

categories.name: Duration
categories.description: Establishes how long the agreement remains in force and how it can be renewed, modified, or terminated.

categories.name: Management
categories.description: Reserves employer authority over business operations while identifying any negotiated limits.

categories.name: Compensation
categories.description: Covers wages and other monetary payments owed to employees.

categories.name: Scheduling
categories.description: Regulates hours of work, workweeks, shifts, overtime allocation, and schedule changes.

categories.name: Leave
categories.description: Covers paid and unpaid time away from work and related eligibility or pay rules.

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.description: Provides medical, dental, vision, and related health-insurance benefits for employees, dependents, or retirees.
examples: Continuation of health coverage during eligible leave

categories.name: Ancillary
categories.description: Provides non-health benefit programs, savings vehicles, insurance benefits, and other deferred or ancillary economic benefits.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: Protects job tenure, seniority, recall rights, and orderly movement between positions.

categories.name: Training
categories.description: Establishes pathways for skill development, advancement, and qualification for higher classifications.

categories.name: Disputes
categories.description: Creates mechanisms for resolving disagreements about contract interpretation, discipline, or workplace issues.

categories.name: Safety
categories.description: Addresses workplace protections, working conditions, equipment, compliance, and employee welfare.

categories.name: Miscellany
categories.description: Captures specialized or cross-cutting clauses that do not fit neatly into a single core employment category.
